promptText:
state: My app keeps crashing on login and nobody has replied in three days!
is_urgent (noul): Is this ticket urgent?
true: Needs a reply within the hour
false: Can wait a day
department (choice): Which department should handle this?
billing: Payments and invoices
technical: Bugs and outages
sales
frustration (score): How frustrated is the customer?
0: Calm
1: Frustrated
2: Very angry
